defs.def: several different sorts of the same thing （同一事物的）不同种类，多种式样

ex.s: It also serves a variety of chef’s specials, beef with rice cakes, and more.
ex.t: 它还供应各种主厨特色菜、年糕炒牛肉等。

ex.s: The spacious dining room is regularly filled with customers enjoying dumplings and a variety of noodle and rice dishes.
ex.t: 宽敞的餐厅里经常坐满享用饺子以及各种面食和米饭菜肴的顾客。

ex.s: It guarantees the variety of food.
ex.t: 它保证食物的多样性。

ex.s: Yellowstone National Park offers a variety of ranger programs throughout the park and throughout the year.
ex.t: 黄石国家公园全年在园内提供各种各样的护林员项目。

ex.s: This variety, coupled with the fact that tiny forests grow up to ten times faster than standard forests, means they attract a rich abundance of wildlife.
ex.t: 这种多样性，加上小森林的生长速度可达标准森林的十倍这一事实，意味着它们吸引了丰富的野生动物。

ex.s: We will be holding a free taster session on 23rd May, at 10 am, to demonstrate the variety of effective and active exercises.
ex.t: 我们将于5月23日上午10点举办一场免费体验课，展示各种有效且活跃的锻炼方式。

ex.s: About 480 varieties of trees may be found in just one hectare of rainforest
ex.t: 仅一公顷雨林中就可能有约480种树木。

ex.s: Other varieties of multigenerational family are more common.
ex.t: 其他类型的多代同堂家庭更为常见。

ex.s: However, a variety of types is represented here.
ex.t: 然而，这里呈现了多种多样的类型。

ex.s: Through the Summer Employment Opportunities program, students are hired each year in a variety of summer positions across the Provincial Public Service, its related agencies and community groups.
ex.t: 通过“暑期就业机会”项目，学生每年会被雇用到省内公共服务部门、相关机构和社区团体的各种暑期岗位。

ex.s: The increasing variety of California big trees.
ex.t: 加州大树的种类越来越多。

ex.s: Join us to taste a variety of fresh local food and drinks.
ex.t: 加入我们，品尝各种新鲜的本地食物和饮品。

ex.s: When hiring committees see this, they see candidate who is capable of working in a variety of environments.
ex.t: 当雇用委员会看到这一点时，他们就会看到能够在各种环境中工作的候选人。

ex.s: More than 750,000 have graduated from SAC, with many seeking employment in engineering, aviation, education, medicine and a wide variety of other professions.
ex.t: 超过750,000人从SAC毕业，许多人在工程、航空、教育等领域寻求就业……

ex.s: An increase in the variety of animals.
ex.t: 动物种类的增加。

ex.s: As the world’s first national park, Yellowstone is famous for the variety of its wildlife, but it is probably best known for its bears.
ex.t: 作为世界上第一个国家公园，黄石公园以其野生动物的多样性而闻名，但它最出名的可能是它的熊。

ex.s: As the world's first national park, Yellowstone is famous for the variety of its wildlife, but it is probably best known for its bears.
ex.t: 作为世界上第一个国家公园，黄石公园以其野生动物的多样性而闻名，但它最广为人知的可能是它的熊。

ex.s: With pleasant flavours and scents, and coming in a variety of colours, fruit and herbal teas make a nice change to traditional teas.
ex.t: 水果茶和草药茶具有令人愉悦的味道和香味，并有多种颜色可供选择，与传统茶叶有很大的不同。

ex.s: Rainforests are home to a rich variety of medicinal plants, food, birds and animals.
ex.t: 雨林是种类丰富的药用植物、食物、鸟类和动物的家园。

defs.def: the quality of not being the same or not doing the same thing all the time 变化；多样化；多变性

ex.s: When the explorers first set foot upon the continent of North American, the skies and lands were alive with an astonishing variety of wildlife.
ex.t: 当探险者首次踏上北美大陆时，天空和大地充满了惊人多样的野生动物。

ex.s: The format of magazines enables children to be exposed to a wide variety of wide subjects.
ex.t: 杂志的形式让孩子接触到广泛多样的主题。

ex.s: Though they are useful for detecting shifts in the number and variety of species in an area, a new Stanford study has found that this type of record is not perfect.
ex.t: 尽管它们有助于发现一个地区物种数量和种类的变化，斯坦福的一项新研究发现这类记录并不完美。

ex.s: This research overturns the popular view that all human speech sounds were present when human beings evolved around 300,000 years ago. ”The set of speech sounds we use has not necessarily remained stable since the appearance of human beings, but rather the huge variety of speech sounds that we find today is the product of a complex interplay of things like biological change and cultural evolution,“ said Steven Moran, a member of the research team.
ex.t: 这项研究推翻了“人类约30万年前进化时所有语音都已存在”的流行观点。“我们使用的语音集合自人类出现以来未必保持稳定，我们今天发现的极其多样的语音，是生物变化和文化演变等事物复杂相互作用的产物，”研究团队成员史蒂文·莫兰说。

ex.s: Most of us， in fact， progressively narrow the variety of our lives． We succeed in our field of specialization and then become trapped in it． Nothing surprises us． We lose our sense of wonder． But， if we are willing to learn， the opportunities are everywhere．
ex.t: 事实上，我们大多数人都在逐渐缩小生活的多样性。我们在自己的专业领域取得成功，然后便被困其中。没有什么能让我们感到惊讶。我们失去了好奇心。但是，如果我们愿意学习，机会无处不在。

defs.def: a type of a thing, for example a plant or language, that is different from the others in the same general group （植物、语言等的）变种，变体；异体；品种

ex.s: Instead, she recommends applying a well-known concept among nutrition experts called the “Division of Responsibility,” where parents provide a variety of mostly healthy foods to their kids at fixed times, and the kids themselves decide what and how much they want to consume — even if that means occasionally eating more cookies than carrots.
ex.t: 相反，她建议采用营养专家中一个知名的理念，叫做“责任分工”：父母在固定时间给孩子提供各种大多健康的食物，而孩子自己决定想吃什么、吃多少——即便这意味着偶尔吃更多饼干而非胡萝卜。

ex.s: Make sure that as you go from interview to interview, you are getting a variety of answers.
ex.t: 确保你在从一个采访转到另一个采访的过程中获得各种各样的答案。

ex.s: Bamboo Family: grass Varieties: Over 1,000 species Size: from a few centimetres to over 30 metres Distribution: Bamboos can be found mostly in East and South-east Asia and on islands of the Indian Ocean and Pacific Ocean.
ex.t: 竹子：科——草本科；品种——超过1000种；尺寸——从几厘米到超过30米；分布——竹子主要分布在东亚和东南亚以及印度洋和太平洋的岛屿上。

defs.def: a form of theatre or television entertainment that consists of a series of short performances, such as singing, dancing and funny acts 综艺节目（包括歌舞、杂耍等的舞台演出或电视节目）

ex.s: It has a complex landscape that includes great gorges, waterfalls and caves systems, pockets of rainforest and a large variety of wildlife.
ex.t: 它拥有复杂的地貌，包括大峡谷、瀑布和洞穴系统、零星的热带雨林以及种类繁多的野生动物。

ex.s: Wander among a variety of shops selling gifts while enjoying a live music show and nice street entertainment.
ex.t: 在售卖礼品的各类店铺间漫步，同时享受现场音乐表演和精彩的街头娱乐。
